Ontology_AssayAndWorkflow_prompt.notes: The experiment uses a custom photoaffinity labeling approach on cellulose membranes, which falls under the broader category of Affinity Purification Mass Spectrometry (AP-MS). Bottom-up mode is inferred from the use of LysC and Trypsin digestion.

cell_lines: To obtain protein extracts we lysed Jurkat cells in lysis buffer.
cereblon, which is expressed in Jurkat cells we used.
scope: Functionalized membranes are then incubated with protein extract and specific targets are identified via quantitative affinity purification and mass spectrometry.
quantitative affinity purification combined with mass spectrometry (q-AP-MS)

The membranes were incubated with the lysate for two hours at 4 °C. After three washes with a detergent-free lysis buffer, membranes were air-dried. Cellulose spots corresponding to individual photocrosslinked compounds were excised and transferred into 96-well plates containing digestion buffer and processed for shotgun proteomic analyses

Ontology_SampleSourceAndScope_prompt.notes: The input material for MS was not the whole cell lysate itself, but the proteins specifically captured/immobilized on the functionalized cellulose membrane via photoaffinity labeling and subsequent affinity purification.
